note: Recast from the original description of Emerson 1952, in English; only the soldier is described there, and the measurements are taken from table 7 of the original.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head somewhat square, the sides fairly straight and parallel; frontal tube relatively long, reaching the anterior margin of the postclypeus from above; lateral corners of the labrum rounded, the margin behind the base of the white median lobe slightly concave or nearly straight; the angle of the notch of the right mandible about a right angle, the cutting edge evenly curved from the notch to the apex; anterior margin of the pronotum distinctly concave; tibial spur formula 2:2:2. Closest to cornutus, which differs in its narrower widest part of the postmentum and its frontal tube, whose base is not as thick as in this species.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head, pronotum, legs and abdomen dark yellow. Vertex and sides sparsely covered with setae, with almost or entirely no contrasting short hairs; underside of the head with few or no setae; anterior end of the postmentum with 2 setae, the middle with a few inconspicuous microscopic hairs. Head somewhat rectangular, the sides fairly straight and parallel. Frontal tube relatively long, reaching the anterior margin of the postclypeus from above. The narrow part of the postmentum is about half the widest part (0.28—0.30:0.58—0.63 mm). Antenna 13—14 segments, the 3rd segment in the 13- and 14-segmented antennae sometimes showing signs of subdivision. Lateral corners of the labrum rounded, the margin behind the base of the white median lobe slightly concave or nearly straight. Mandibles as in figure 10, the angle of the notch of the right mandible about a right angle, the cutting edge evenly curved from the notch to the apex. Anterior margin of the pronotum distinctly concave. Tibial spur formula 2:2:2. Measurements: head including mandibles 3.32—3.65, head length to the tip of the frontal tube 2.33—2.65, head length to the lateral base of the mandibles 2.41—2.74, head width 1.72—1.94, head thickness 1.62—1.66, frontal tube length 0.41—0.46, labrum width 0.52—0.56, left mandible length 1.26—1.32, right mandible length from the notch 0.62—0.66, pronotum length 0.57—0.60, width 0.99—1.06, hind tibia length 1.47—1.53 mm (n=3). Type locality Iguassú, Bahia, Brazil (about 13°24′S, 43°10′W); the holotype soldier and paratype soldiers were taken by A. Roman in 1924 in dead wood in caatinga scrub.
